articles.title: Google Maps Sends Car Onto Incomplete Flyover in UP—3 Escape Death in Maharajganj!
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A major mishap was narrowly avoided on the Gorakhpur–Sonauli highway in Maharajganj, Uttar Pradesh, when a car using Google Maps drove onto an under-construction flyover and got stuck. The incident took place near Farenda around 1 AM on Sunday.

body.html:
A major mishap was narrowly avoided on the Gorakhpur–Sonauli highway in Maharajganj, Uttar Pradesh, when a car using Google Maps drove onto an under-construction flyover and got stuck. The incident took place near Farenda around 1 AM on Sunday.

The Lucknow-registered car was en route to Sonauli when Google Maps guided it onto the unfinished flyover. With no barricades or warning signs in place, the car went over the edge but stopped just in time. All three occupants, residents of Gorakhpur, escaped unhurt.

Police and rescue teams arrived promptly, and the car was removed with help from the construction agency. Locals blamed the lack of signage and barricading, while this adds to growing concerns over overreliance on GPS navigation.

Earlier, a similar Google Maps mishap in Bareilly led to the death of three people after their car fell from an incomplete bridge.

articles.title: 25-Year-Old Lawyer Dies Suddenly on Camera in Lucknow Tehsil – Another Heart Attack Horror!
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: #InShort | 25-Year-Old Lawyer Dies Suddenly at Lucknow Tehsil Office Abhishek Kewal alias Pawan Singh collapsed and died of a heart attack near the Sarojini Nagar Tehsil gate. CCTV shows him walking normally seconds before the fatal collapse. Family says he had no medical history.

body.html:
#InShort | 25-Year-Old Lawyer Dies Suddenly at Lucknow Tehsil Office
Abhishek Kewal alias Pawan Singh collapsed and died of a heart attack near the Sarojini Nagar Tehsil gate. CCTV shows him walking normally seconds before the fatal collapse. Family says he had no medical history.

* * *

A 25-year-old lawyer, Abhishek Kewal alias Pawan Singh, died of a sudden heart attack on Monday at Sarojini Nagar Tehsil Office in Lucknow. CCTV footage shows Abhishek walking with fellow lawyers when he suddenly collapsed near the gate and died on the spot.

He was rushed to the hospital but was declared dead on arrival. The video, now viral on social media, shows him appearing completely normal seconds before the collapse.

Abhishek lived near Hanuman Temple on Kanpur Road and practiced law at Lucknow Tehsil. His family claims he had no prior medical history.

This adds to the growing number of sudden heart attack deaths across India, raising serious health concerns.
